false_findings: Finding 9 asserts, as fact about the code, «`isRetryable` (рядок 136-139) ловить будь-який `AppError` зі `status >= 500`». AppError has no `status` — the field is `statusCode` (server/src/platform/errors.ts:9-19) — so the left branch is always false. This run is the only one of the ten that misses that bug, and it goes further by describing the broken branch as working; the claim is what makes its markdown-retry scenario sound reachable.
notes: Hits all nine assertions and states the causal chain from the missing overrides entry to the vi.mock more explicitly than most («Це причина, а не збіг»). Repo citations verified: 7 ports in vendor/shared/adapters.ts, schema.ts:3-6 tenancy header, server-unit.yml:106 / server-integration.yml:65, no-orphans comment at .dependency-cruiser.cjs:43-46 (and correctly reported as a warn-severity rule elsewhere). The one substantive defect is the AppError.status mischaracterisation recorded above.
